instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: the PS2 is the best console ever.

San Andreas, Kingdom Hearts, Silent Hill 2, Burnout 3. The PS2 library has no weak genre. Metal Gear Solid 3 squeezed a living jungle out of hardware from 2000. It pushed the PS2 far past its limits. From God of War to 155 million consoles sold, nothing has matched its run. Agree?
